entities.name: Tiny
entities.description: Dog detective from Ravnica, a sniffer dog formerly failing at the Agency of Magicological Investigations, partnered with Sophia.

entities.name: Sophia
entities.description: Detective partnered with Tiny after failing at her own investigations.

events.summary: Tiny was paired with Sophia, who learned to rely on his instincts while he stopped being distracted by treats.
events.quote: He was eventually paired up with Sophia due to her similarly being unsuccessful at her detective investigations.

relations.quote: Together, they've been able to make up for each other's weaknesses.
